title: Tareitas Privacy Policy
intro: Tareitas (“Tareitas”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) is a family application designed to help parents and children manage daily tasks, routines, stars, and rewards.
This Privacy Policy explains what information Tareitas may process, how it is stored and used, and the choices available to users.

sections.title: 1. Information We Process
paragraphs: Depending on the features used and the storage mode selected, Tareitas may process the following information:
list: Images uploaded by users for tasks or rewards
Information related to advertising when the user has not subscribed to an ad-free version
Users may choose whether their family data is stored only on their device or synchronized across multiple devices.

sections.title: 2. Storage Modes
paragraphs: Multidevices Mode
When a user selects Multidevices, family data is stored on our server to allow the data to be synchronized between the user's devices.
Server-stored data may include:
This information is used to provide the application's synchronization and family-management features.
Only This Device Mode
When a user selects Only this device, the application's family data is stored locally on the user's device and is not uploaded to our server for synchronization.
However, analytics, crash-reporting, and advertising services may still process information as described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 3. Images and User-Created Content
paragraphs: Tareitas allows users to upload images to customize tasks and rewards.
Users are responsible for ensuring that they have the appropriate rights to upload any images they choose to use.
In Multidevices mode, uploaded task and reward images may be stored on our server so they can be synchronized across the user's devices.
In Only this device mode, these images are stored locally on the user's device and are not uploaded to our server for synchronization.
Users should avoid uploading sensitive or unnecessary personal information in images.

sections.title: 4. How We Use Information
paragraphs: Information processed by Tareitas may be used to:
list: Provide and operate the application's features
Synchronize family data between devices when Multidevices mode is selected
Display tasks, routines, stars, and rewards
Store and display user-uploaded images and avatars
Diagnose crashes and other technical issues
Provide advertising to users who have not subscribed to the ad-free version

sections.title: 5. Analytics and Crash Reporting
paragraphs: Tareitas may use analytics and crash-reporting technologies to understand application usage, identify technical problems, diagnose crashes, and improve the application's performance and reliability.
These services may collect technical information about the application and device, such as information about crashes, performance, and application usage.

sections.title: 6. Advertising
paragraphs: If a user has not subscribed to an ad-free version of Tareitas, the application may display advertisements.
Advertising providers may collect or process information necessary to provide, personalize, measure, and improve advertising, subject to their applicable privacy policies and settings.

sections.title: 7. Children's Information
paragraphs: Tareitas is designed for families and may allow parents or guardians to enter information about children, such as:
list: Images associated with tasks or rewards

paragraphs: Parents or guardians are responsible for the information they enter into the application.
Tareitas does not require children to provide an email address or other direct contact information to use the application's family features.
Users should not upload unnecessary sensitive personal information about children.

sections.title: 8. Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We may use third-party service providers to provide services necessary for the operation of Tareitas, including services related to:
These providers may process information as necessary to provide their services.
We do not sell users' personal information.

sections.title: 9. Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable measures designed to protect information processed by Tareitas against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
However, no method of electronic storage or transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: 10. Data Retention and Deletion
paragraphs: For information stored on our servers, we retain the information for as long as necessary to provide the applicable Tareitas services or as otherwise required for legitimate operational or legal purposes.
Users may request deletion of their server-stored personal information by contacting us using the email address below.

For information stored only on the user's device, the user can remove the information using the applicable functionality provided by the application or by removing the application's stored data from the device.

sections.title: 12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
When we make changes, we will update the Last updated date at the top of this Privacy Policy. The updated Privacy Policy will be made available at the same public URL.
